title: Planethunt: archival evidence for the KIC 5689121 transit candidate
description: Dated scripts, measurements, query provenance, scientific limitations and an author-review RNAAS manuscript for an unconfirmed 13.769-day transit candidate associated with KIC 5689121. Modelled FPP is approximately 6.9%; unresolved host identity and novelty remain provisional. Original text, figures and analysis products are CC BY 4.0; original code is MIT. Third-party material retains its existing terms; see LICENSE and SOURCES.md. Large bulk-data archives are linked in publication/2026-10-13/bulk-data-manifest.json and are not included merely by being linked. The manuscript is a draft, not a journal submission or accepted publication.
